{{Quote|Bessen, you are the stupidest trooper I've ever had the displeasure to command.|Captain Savar|<ref name="Outcast" />}}
'''Bessen''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Reproduction/Legends|born]] around [[26 ABY/Legends|26 ABY]]. He was a [[Trooper/Legends|trooper]] in [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] [[Galactic Alliance Security|Security]], and in [[43 ABY]], he took part in the arrest of [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], who had been charged with dereliction of duty. During the arrest, Bessen inadvertently shot at Skywalker with his [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifle]]. The bolt missed, and the situation was quickly brought back under control. Bessen's [[Captain/Legends|captain]], [[Savar]], punished Bessen for firing on the [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoner]] by making him run back to the [[Galactic Alliance Security blockhouse|Security blockhouse]] on [[Limb/Legends|foot]], while Savar transported Skywalker there via [[Airspeeder/Legends|speeder]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|Sergeant Carn, come watch him do two-hundred push-ups, then acquire transport and watch him ''run'' back to the blockhouse on foot.|Captain Savar, to Sergeant Carn, on Bessen|<ref name="Outcast" />}}
[[File:Luke_Skywalker_EA.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Bessen was sent to help arrest Jedi Master Luke Skywalker (pictured).]]
Bessen was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] born around [[26 ABY/Legends|26 ABY]], during the time of the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]]. He later became a [[Trooper/Legends|trooper]] in [[Galactic Alliance Security]], a security force located on the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. There, he served under the command of Security [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Savar]]. In [[43 ABY|43.5 ABY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[Fate of the Jedi: Outcast]]'' to [[43 ABY]].</ref> Bessen took part in the arrest of [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], who had been indicted with failing to prevent former [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Darth Caedus|Jacen Solo's]] fall to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]]. The Security troopers were joined by three [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] hired by the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances]]&mdash;[[Skakoan/Legends|Skakoan]] [[Politics/Legends|politician]] [[Hrym Mawarr]], Human [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] hunter [[Jesmin Tainer|Zilaash Kuh]], and [[Quarren/Legends|Quarren]] inventor [[Dhidal Nyz]].<ref name="Outcast" />

During the arrest, ex-[[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], who was accompanying Skywalker at the time, insulted Savar, causing the captain to stiffen. Nyz assumed that Skywalker was attempting to use [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] on the captain, and he exclaimed that the prisoner was resisting. Surprised by the sudden commotion, Bessen lost his nerve and involuntarily fired off a shot at the Jedi from his [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]]. Skywalker dodged the bolt, and [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Kam Solusar]], who had also been accompanying Skywalker at the time of his arrest, deflected the shot aside with his [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]]. Solo abruptly shot Bessen's gun out of his hand, destroying it before he could fire it again. As the situation was brought back under control, Savar punished Bessen for firing on the prisoner and ordered [[Carn]], a [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]], to watch him do 200 push-ups and then run back to the [[Galactic Alliance Security blockhouse]] on foot. Meanwhile, Savar and the other Security troopers took Skywalker back to the blockhouse in the captain's personnel carrier [[Airspeeder/Legends|speeder]].<ref name="Outcast" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Who told you to shoot the prisoner?''"<br />"''No one, sir, I didn't&mdash;I didn't mean&mdash;''"<br />"''Good answer. 'I didn't mean to, I'm just incompetent.' Are you competent to do two hundred push-ups for me?|Savar and Bessen, after Bessen shot at Skywalker|<ref name="Outcast" />}}
Due to his inexperience in the field, Bessen was slightly anxious and easily startled, resulting in his reflexive shot at Skywalker. He was also proved to be passive and compliant following this mistake, accepting punishment from his superior officer without complaint.<ref name="Outcast" />

==Equipment==
Bessen wore the standard [[Color/Legends|blue]] uniform and helmet of the Galactic Alliance Security, along with black riot [[Armor/Legends|armor]] covering his chest, forearms, and lower legs. He also carried a [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifle]].<ref name="Outcast" />

==Behind the scenes==
Bessen appeared in ''[[Fate of the Jedi: Outcast]]'', the first novel in the nine-part [[Star Wars: Fate of the Jedi|''Fate of the Jedi'']] series that was written by [[Aaron Allston]] and published in [[2009]].<ref name="Outcast" />
